method: Read saved candidate diagnostic category statuses only; no generation, fitting, validation or collision calls. Only explicit pass counts as passed; unavailable and not_evaluated never pass.
protected_surface_scope: Task/interface compatibility, reported explicitly and included in final_goal_valid/joint_valid; contact_valid describes local support/closing geometry without reserving assembly surfaces. contact_with_protected supplies the stricter alternative.
units: Candidate-placement evaluations (100 proposals x12 parts x8 scenes=9600 per method) and placements with at least one passing candidate. CAD-relative proposal/contact banks are reused across scenes, so9600 is not9600 independent grasps or physical trials.
